title: Combat card window: a way back from the card pick
description: When you hold several different action cards for a reaction window, the window first asks 'Choose an action card...' (with Pass) and then lists the cards. That second step used to offer only the cards, so after saying yes you could not back out without playing one. It now offers a decline too, shown as 'Back, do not play a card'. Before shots use the old offer (no decline); after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CB. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

notes.title: Root cause
notes.text: The engine's inner 'play an action card' choice (reactions.rs) had no decline option, although the card rule is 'may'. It now adds one and the slot is offered again, so the window's own Pass still ends the window.
